title: UAAP: Lady Bullpups cruise past UE to boost Final 4 bid
summary: National University moved closer to a Final 4 spot in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament after overpowering University of the East, 94-40, on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum.
